name: Themes & Color Schemes
changes: Adds twelve user-selectable color themes: Night, Light, Midnight, Ocean, Emerald, Amethyst, Rosewood, Sunset, Arctic, Graphite, Sandstone, and Aurora.
Keeps Night visually identical to the v3.6.93 production appearance by wrapping the existing stylesheet colors with exact fallbacks rather than redesigning the interface.
Adds presentation-only local theme persistence, instant Settings preview, pre-paint theme restoration, and light color-scheme handling without changing backend settings or application behavior.

Preserves the v3.6.93 Defender-clean native helper/build pipeline, updater, installer, Automation/Wanted/Smart Import, Newsgroup Browser, Discover, Downloads, SABnzbd 5.1.2, Metadata Server v0.3.3, and Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31.
regression_guards: The v3.6.93 stylesheet must reconstruct byte-for-byte from v3.6.94 Night fallback colors, proving the existing Night appearance was not redesigned.
All twelve theme IDs must be present in the pre-paint bootstrap, Settings selector, application theme registry, and themes.css.
Light, Arctic, and Sandstone must use light color-scheme; all other themes remain dark.
Theme selection is stored only in localStorage and may not be added to the backend /api/settings payload.
Every alternate palette must meet the release contrast floor for primary text, secondary text, muted text, accent contrast, and semantic status colors.
The Defender-clean folder-only Picker, accepted yEnc helper, direct verified-Setup updater, and v3.6.93 installed-upgrade smoke architecture remain unchanged.
